paragraph: On 15 May 2026 Angola's Institute of Administrative Modernisation (IMA) [issued terms of reference to procure an e-learning platform for the civil-service school ENAPP](<https://c2a.portais.gov.ao/uploads/Td_R_Apoio_a_ENAPP_na_Digitalizacao_da_Oferta_Formativa_E_learning_e052ddd6ac.pdf>). In the last twelve months, [a presidential despacho of October 2026 authorised USD 20 million for a PADA digital-skills programme](<https://valoreconomico.co.ao/artigo/pr-autoriza-mais-70-milhoes-de-dolares-para-a-transformacao-digital-do-pais>). It is for working people and public servants. [Another ordered a public tender for training centres to raise public servants' digital skills at three levels](<https://poligrafoafrica.com/fact-check/joao-lourenco-autoriza-despesa-de-20-milhoes-usd-para-capacitacao-digital-em-angola/>). No source found since October 2023 says a standing programme is in service or gives a number trained. Establishing would need a programme, academy or platform in service with a stated number of civil servants trained.

In September 2026 the PAFEN coordinator said in a [LinkedIn post that PAFEN will soon launch a basic digital-skills programme](<https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7509922575322566656>). It aims to train 5,000 civil servants in under twelve months. In the last twelve months, that announcement is the only development found for Burundi. No source found says the programme has begun, or that it has trained a stated number of public servants. Establishing would need a programme, academy or platform in service with a stated number of civil servants trained.

[La Marina BJ reports that the State trained 1,500 public administration agents for ICDL certification in 2022](<https://lamarinabj.com/index.php/2024/07/16/benin-une-nouvelle-vague-de-formation-icdl-pour-les-agents-de-ladministration/>), and that ASIN was to oversee a second wave of 351 agents in 2024. In the last twelve months, [ASIN and the Police républicaine's information systems directorate ran a training campaign from 26 June to 8 July 2026](<https://www.dgpr.bj/techniques-de-protection-des-informations-sensibles-de-letat-lagence-des-systemes-dinformation-et-du-numerique-asin-et-direction-des-systemes-dinformation-et-de/>). It reached 300 police civil servants in six localities. They learned to protect sensitive state information and to use national e-signature, encryption and secure-messaging tools. No source found since October 2023 says a standing programme is in service. Establishing would need a programme, academy or platform in service with a stated number of civil servants trained.

On 4 November 2026 a public-finance training project, DISMEFIP, [began courses for more than 400 tax agents](<https://lefaso.net/spip.php?article150547>). They learn three of the tax directorate's digital platforms, in four cities. The project runs from 2026 to 2028, paid for equally by Swiss cooperation and the government. In the last twelve months, these courses are the training found for one directorate. The World Bank's [PACTDIGITAL project includes public-administration skills](<https://projects.worldbank.org/en/projects-operations/project-detail/P177022>), as reported in March 2024. No source found says a standing programme has trained a stated number of civil servants. Establishing would need a programme, academy or platform in service with a stated number of civil servants trained.

On 6 October 2026 Statistics Botswana and the Botswana Public Service College [agreed to design a statistical and data-literacy course for public servants](<https://dailynews.gov.bw/news-detail/93566>). In the last twelve months, that agreement is the training found; it is meant for staff across the National Statistical System. Vice President Ndaba Gaolathe said [AI training for the civil service was being planned](<https://dailynews.gov.bw/news-detail/87072>). After a 2023 review of the 1Gov portal, [training sessions for civil servants were put in motion](<https://www.adm.ee/blog/case-study-botswana-1gov-platform-assessment/>), ADM Interactive says. It gives no number trained. Establishing would need a programme, academy or platform in service with a stated number of civil servants trained.

The World Bank [counts 367 civil servants and beneficiaries trained, against a target of 2,000 by December 2026](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099122024184018568/txt/P1746201172f3b05d1a9d118f1eb4b91506.txt>), after training sessions held in 2024 under its digital government component. In the last twelve months, on 9 October 2026, the digital economy ministry [signed a renewable five-year agreement with HSE University, Moscow](<https://www.wearetech.africa/fr/fils/actualites/gestion-publique/numerique-la-centrafrique-se-tourne-vers-la-russie-pour-former-ses-fonctionnaires>). It aims to strengthen civil servants' digital governance skills. A Ministry of Public Service official says [computer training of civil servants has started at the Alliance Francaise](<https://oubanguimedias.com/2025/09/19/centrafrique-vers-une-gestion-modernisee-des-ressources-humaines-dans-ladministration-publique/>), beginning with the ministry. No source found since October 2023 says a standing programme is in service. Establishing would need a programme, academy or platform in service with a stated number of civil servants trained.

SNDI's training centre, opened in 2012, [had trained more than 28,500 civil servants and state agents by August 2024](<https://www.fratmat.info/article/304692/societe/tic-190-agents-de-letat-formes-aux-outils-numeriques>). In the last twelve months, [the total passed 37,500 by July 2026, after a 40-day course for 192 agents in the Hambol region](<https://www.fratmat.info/article/2643657/regions/katiolatic-192-agents-administratifs-formes-dans-le-hambol>). In February 2026 the public service ministry [began the operational phase of a FCFA 8 billion e-learning platform for all civil servants, to run to 2029](<https://www.afriksoir.net/cote-divoire-projet-digitalisation-fonction-publique-ena-entre-phase-operationnelle/>). [The 2026-2028 roadmap plans AI training for over 2,000 public officials by 2027](<https://www.koaci.com/article/2026/10/12/cote-divoire/politique/cote-divoire-assemblee-nationale-patrick-achi-ouvre-la-voie-a-lintelligence-artificielle-dans-le-travail-parlementaire_201534.html>), the digital minister said in October 2026. No source found says digital-skills training reaches civil servants across government. Operating would need the programme open to all ministries, or staff trained across most of government.

On 21 September 2026 Cameroon's government [launched the online platform train.patnucelearning.cm under PATNUC](<https://www.digitalbusiness.africa/cameroun-train-patnucelearning-cm-la-plateforme-numerique-lancee-pour-former-15-000-agents-publics-a-lia-la-blockchain-et-la-transformation-digitale/>), with a target of 15,000 civil servants and public-enterprise staff. In the last twelve months, in August 2026, the agriculture ministry reported that [the PATNUC programme was open to agents of public administrations nationwide](<https://www.minader.cm/index.php/2026/08/27/transformation-numerique-le-patnuc-lance-une-vaste-formation-destinee-aux-agents-publics-camerounais/>). It has five certifying online modules, including AI and blockchain. [The programme is stated to be open to agents of all ministries, including deconcentrated services](<https://www.digitalbusiness.africa/cameroun-train-patnucelearning-cm-la-plateforme-numerique-lancee-pour-former-15-000-agents-publics-a-lia-la-blockchain-et-la-transformation-digitale/>). No source found since October 2023 gives the share of the civil service trained in digital skills. Mature would need the share of civil servants trained published, or the number trained beside the headcount.

In November 2023 the digital agency ADN and Africa Digital Academy [agreed to train 100,000 public agents in 2024-2025](<https://ouragan.cd/2023/11/digitalisation-de-la-rdc-ladn-et-lada-sengagent-a-former-100-000-agents>) in cybersecurity, AI and digital transformation. In the last twelve months, ADN, with KADEA and ULB-Solvay, [held the first session of an executive programme in digital transformation and AI on 28-30 September 2026](<https://adn.cd/fr/actualites/l-adn-en-collaboration-avec-kadea-et-ulb-solvay-lifelong-learning-a-organise-un-programme-executive-en-transformation-digitale-et-intelligence-artificielle>). It was for cadres of 30 public institutions. In September 2025 the education ministry [began 15-day computing courses, in groups of 20, for staff of its central services](<https://edu-nc.gouv.cd/actualites/digitalisation-de-ladministration-le-ministere-forme-ses-agents-aux-outils-numeriques-et-a-la-micro-informatique>). No source found since October 2023 says a standing programme is in service. Establishing would need a programme, academy or platform in service with a stated number of civil servants trained.

The Agence Congolaise des Systemes d'Information [runs an office-skills training programme for staff of public administrations](<https://acsi.cg/actualites/renforcement-de-competences-numeriques-des-agents-de-la-dgcpp-par-lacsi/>), with a session scheduled from 23 March to 17 April 2026. In the last twelve months, ACSI scheduled that session for staff of the Direction Generale des Comptes Publics et du Patrimoine. Les Depeches de Brazzaville reports that the World Bank-funded PATN project [opened training centres for public-sector agents of the Posts, Telecommunications and Digital Economy department](<https://www.adiac-congo.com/content/patn-des-agents-publics-formes-la-gestion-des-bases-de-donnees-numeriques-159517>). Sessions run at least 30 hours, on database management. No source found since October 2023 says a standing programme is in service. Establishing would need a programme, academy or platform in service with a stated number of civil servants trained.

In December 2023 AFD said that [training under its PAGF-SI project strengthens the digital skills of the Ministry of Finance's agents](<https://www.afd.fr/fr/projets/projet-appui-la-gouvernance-financiere-systeme-information-comores>). The aim is that they can adopt the new tools. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says digital-skills training reaches civil servants across government, or that a standing programme is in service. Establishing would need a programme, academy or platform in service with a stated number of civil servants trained.

In May 2026 [Resolução 72/2026 recognised as progress digital-inclusion and skills-training initiatives developed for citizens and public servants](<https://boe.incv.cv/Bulletins/DownloadAct?id=101313>). In the last twelve months, the justice modernisation institute [said 110 justice professionals had been trained in artificial intelligence by September 2026](<https://expressodasilhas.cv/pais/2026/09/17/justica-digital-ja-poupa-23-milhoes-de-folhas-de-papel/104656>), among them judges, prosecutors and court officers. The government's national capacity programme is [Administração Pública + Digital](<https://luma.com/s1lhffqr>). It announced a pilot digital-skills course for public servants on 22-26 September 2025 at the state modernisation ministry in Praia. No source found since October 2023 says a standing programme is in service. Establishing would need a programme, academy or platform in service with a stated number of civil servants trained.

In February 2025 Djibouti's Ministry of Digital Economy and Innovation [launched a digital-skills programme for government officials with DCO, Oracle University and INAP](<https://www.wearetech.africa/en/fils-uk/news/public-management/djibouti-launches-digital-skills-program-for-government-officials>). It covers cloud, AI, cybersecurity and data management through Oracle MyLearn. The digital economy minister cited [the training of 400 public-sector and civil-society executives through Coursera](<https://www.techreviewafrica.com/news/2012/djibouti-hosts-high-level-workshop-on-digital-transformation-and-emerging-technologies>) among the government's initiatives in 2025. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No news story or official notice found gives the number of officials the Oracle programme has trained. Establishing would need a programme, academy or platform in service with a stated number of civil servants trained.

In 2024 the Ministry of National Education [said it launched a project with UNESCO and the EU to build an e-learning platform](<https://www.itu.int/en/ITU-D/Regional-Presence/ArabStates/Documents/events/2024/MeaningfulConnectivity/Presentations/Session4/Pr%C3%A9sentation_MrKhelladi_Ministere%20de%20l'Education%20Nationale%20Algerie.pdf>). It first trains a core group of inspectors in pedagogical engineering. The inspectors then train teachers to produce multimedia courses. Teachers are counted among the ministry's 1,019,509 fonctionnaires. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says a standing programme for civil servants is in service. Establishing would need a programme, academy or platform in service with a stated number of civil servants trained.

In November 2024 the deputy ICT minister [said the state capacity-building plan had issued 146,695 training certificates](<https://www.elwatannews.com/news/details/7692723>). [The Fundamentals of Digital Skills Program, implemented by ICDL Arabia, targets all employees of the state's administrative apparatus](<https://mcit.gov.eg/en/Human_Capacity/MCIT/States_Administrative_Apparatus_Employees>). The deputy minister said most of its leaders and staff had been trained. In the last twelve months, [between March and May 2026 UNESCO and MCIT trained more than 90 civil servants from 25 ministries in AI literacy](<https://www.unesco.org/en/articles/strengthening-ai-literacy-egypts-civil-servants>). [In October 2026 the communications and labour ministries signed an MoU on digital capacity for Labour Ministry staff](<https://sis.gov.eg/en/media-center/news/communications-minister-joint-efforts-to-boost-youth-digital-skills/>). No source found since October 2023 gives the share of the civil service trained in digital skills. Mature would need the share of civil servants trained published, or the number trained beside the headcount.

No stage is set. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Nothing found since October 2023 says whether civil servants in Eritrea are trained in digital skills, and no source from the past three years says they receive none. Preparing would need a government body to have launched, piloted or prepared a digital-skills programme for civil servants, or to have held digital-skills courses for officials.

[UNCDF reports that the Ministry of Innovation and Technology led a three-day nationwide Digital Financial Literacy campaign](<https://www.uncdf.org/article/9151/closing-ethiopias-digital-finance-gap-one-woman-civil-servant-at-a-time>), held in April 2026. In the last twelve months, that campaign trained 525 public-sector participants from 26 public institutions, targeting women civil servants. Addis Fortune reports that [by August 2025 more than 120,000 Addis Abeba government employees had enrolled in Udacity courses in coding, AI and data science](<https://addisfortune.news/civil-servants-rush-to-secure-digital-certificates-skills-take-a-back-seat>). Many skipped the content to collect certificates. No source found since October 2023 says a standing programme is in service. Establishing would need a programme, academy or platform in service with a stated number of civil servants trained.

GabonReview says a DGPE course of 7 to 17 October 2025 in Libreville [trained nearly 300 agents](<https://www.gabonreview.com/dgpe-300-agents-formes-en-ia-cybersecurite-et-informatique/>). In the last twelve months, on 7 September 2026, the Centre Gabonais de l'Innovation [ran an introductory AI-tools session for over forty agents of the Ministry of Communication and Media](<https://agpgabon.ga/gabon-cgi-des-agents-du-ministere-de-la-communication-et-des-medias-inities-a-lutilisation-de-lia/>). The RCAPE programme plans to train 500 state agents by December 2026. Treasury agents [took a three-day course in digital tools and AI at the Centre in September 2026](<https://gabonactu.com/blog/2026/09/10/intelligence-artificielle-des-agents-de-letat-se-mettent-a-jour/>). No source found since October 2023 says a standing programme is in service. Establishing would need a programme, academy or platform in service with a stated number of civil servants trained.

In 2024, 520 public and civil servants from 53 ministries, departments and agencies [graduated from the DigSMART Scale-Up programme, Graphic Online reports](<https://www.graphic.com.gh/news/general-news/520-public-sector-staff-trained-in-digsmart.html>). In July 2025 the communication minister [announced a plan to train 200,000 civil servants in AI and coding](<https://ghanaiantimes.com.gh/embrace-digital-reforms-for-rapid-technological-advancement-communication-minister/>), under the One Million Coders Programme. In the last twelve months, in August 2026, Deputy Minister Sukparu said [the government has begun an AI capacity-building programme for public-sector officials](<https://techafricanews.com/2026/08/20/ghana-opens-2026-national-ict-week-ai-digital-skills/>). It is run with UNESCO, UNDP and Japan. No source found since October 2023 gives the share of the civil service trained in digital skills. Mature would need the share of civil servants trained published, or the number trained beside the headcount.

On 23 September 2026 the state digitalisation agency ANDE [validated the feasibility study for a National Digital Academy](<https://www.africaguinee.com/souverainete-numerique-en-guinee-lande-au-coeur-de-la-creation-de-lacademie-nationale-du-numerique/>). It is to offer short certified courses aimed first at civil servants. In the last twelve months, the National School of Administration [trained 30 national and general directors in digital transformation, AI and cybersecurity on 13-15 October 2026](<https://www.africaguinee.com/modernisation-de-ladministration-en-guinee-lena-forme-la-haute-fonction-publique-a-lia-et-a-la-cybersecurite/>), for the public service ministry. [On 15 May 2026 the civil service ministry presented nine projects, among them training public servants to use digital tools](<https://www.wearetech.africa/fr/fils/actualites/tech/la-guinee-lance-neuf-chantiers-numeriques-pour-moderniser-l-administration>). No source found since October 2023 says a standing programme is in service. Establishing would need a programme, academy or platform in service with a stated number of civil servants trained.

In December 2025 The Gambia's Ministry of Communications and Digital Economy [signed a framework agreement with Smart Africa, TechAfrica News reports](<https://techafricanews.com/2025/12/17/the-gambia-partners-with-smart-africa-to-launch-digital-skills-academy/>). It is to implement the Smart Africa Digital Academy, which will train policymakers and public sector leaders among others. In the last twelve months, that agreement is the step found towards an academy. No source found says the academy has trained anyone. The Point reports that the Ministry of Public Service [ran a five-day Microsoft Power BI data analytics training from 24 March 2025](<https://thepoint.gm/africa/gambia/national-news/mops-training-on-data-analytics-using-microsoft-power-bi-underway>) for at least 16 staff. Establishing would need a programme, academy or platform in service with a stated number of civil servants trained.

By June 2026 the government and UNDP, with EU funding, had run a [roughly 30-hour Word, Excel and PowerPoint course under the +Digit@l and Justisa pa Tudu Djintis projects](<https://www.undp.org/sites/g/files/zskgke326/files/2026-07/undp_g.b_newsletter_apr-jun_2026_eng.pdf>). In the last twelve months, the course reached justice and human rights professionals, among others, alongside a 36-hour trainer programme. In October 2025 UNDP and the Technological Institute for Administrative Modernization (ITMA) [ran a three-day course on data security and protection](<https://www.undp.org/sites/g/files/zskgke326/files/2026-02/undp_g.b_newsletter_oct-dec_2025_eng.pdf>). It trained ITMA staff and civil servants to train others across the public service. No source found since October 2023 says a standing programme is in service. Establishing would need a programme, academy or platform in service with a stated number of civil servants trained.

In January 2025 the government [presented an INAP training plan for central-administration civil servants](<https://www.guineaecuatorialpress.com/noticias/presentacion_del_plan_de_formacion_capacitacion_y_reciclaje_para_funcionarios_impulsado_por_el_gobierno>), which runs from 23 February 2025 and includes basic digital competencies and typing courses. On 15 July 2025 CNIAPGE [began a 10-day training for more than 50 officials of the Primatura](<https://realequatorialguinea.com/destacado/cniapge-forma-a-funcionarios-de-la-primatura-en-el-uso-de-la-plataforma-de-gestion-de-expedientes/>) on the GEX case-file platform. It is to be extended to ministerial departments. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says a standing programme is in service. Establishing would need a programme, academy or platform in service with a stated number of civil servants trained.

In November 2025 UNESCO and the Kenya School of Government [launched a free online course on AI and digital transformation for civil servants](<https://www.unesco.org/en/articles/kenya-launches-unesco-oxford-free-online-course-ai-and-digital-transformation>). The programme behind it aims to train 20,000 by 2027. In the last twelve months, the School says [13,790 public servants completed Phase I of its AI and Digital Skilling Project by February 2026](<https://ksg.ac.ke/rcoc-sets-the-stage-for-phase-2/>). In October 2026 [its eLITI institute opened as 1,239 public officers graduated from that course](<https://techafricanews.com/2026/10/13/kenya-ksg-digital-institute-1239-public-officers-ai-training/>), [out of a first cohort of 2,730](<https://www.jointsdgfund.org/article/kenya-expands-ai-training-strengthen-public-services-and-digital-governance>). No source found since October 2023 says digital-skills training reaches civil servants across government. Operating would need the programme open to all ministries, or staff trained across most of government.

On 22 January 2026 the Public Procurement and Concessions Commission [concluded a seven-day digital literacy training for its staff](<https://micat.gov.lr/index.php/office/news/newsroom/press-release/ppcc-concludes-digital-literacy-training>), the information ministry reports. It ended in certification. In the last twelve months, CSquared states that [Liberia has begun preparing for AI through AI training for civil servants with the UNDP](<https://www.einpresswire.com/article/939735610/csquared-completes-commercial-broadband-programme-in-liberia-with-support-from-microsoft>). No news story or official notice found gives a number of civil servants trained by a standing programme in Liberia. Establishing would need a programme, academy or platform in service with a stated number of civil servants trained.

On 14 September 2025 the Ministry of Civil Service [launched a one-week computer-applications course for government employees in Benghazi, Libya Update reports, citing LANA](<https://libyaupdate.com/the-civil-service-launches-a-specialized-training-program-in-computer-applications-in-benghazi/>). It was the first of a series on electronic archiving. The Ministry of Labour and Rehabilitation [held a basic computer-skills workshop for its staff in Sirte that closed on 26 August 2025](<https://www.lananews.com/ar/?p=438824>). In May 2025 the Libyan Digital Lab and Expertise France [held a workshop on adapting France's Pix digital-skills platform](<https://eu4skills.ly/pix-platform-and-national-maturity/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says a standing programme is in service. Establishing would need a programme, academy or platform in service with a stated number of civil servants trained.

The [2027/28 Budget Strategy Paper directs medium-term budget support to a public-service digital and AI literacy programme](<https://budgetportal.finance.gov.ls/PDFDocuments/2027-2028%20Budget%20Strategy%20Paper-639276738396119649.pdf>) and attaches no amount. In September 2025 the ICT ministry and LIPAM [held a one-day session for officers in Mohale's Hoek on the use of technology in ministries](<https://www.lena.gov.ls/tiheli-urges-public-servants-to-embrace-change/>). In August 2023 the ICT ministry [began a cyber security training workshop for government officials](<https://www.gov.ls/uncategorized/internet-impacts-daily-activities-dps/>), run with Tethics. No standing programme has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says a standing programme is in service. Establishing would need a programme, academy or platform in service with a stated number of civil servants trained.

In September 2024 the Digital Development Agency [launched the e-TAMKEEN e-learning programme on its Academia Raqmya platform](<https://www.wearetech.africa/en/fils-uk/news/morocco-launches-online-training-to-boost-public-digital-capacity>). Between 2019 and 2023 it had trained more than 6,800 civil servants at central and local levels on 23 digital topics. In the last twelve months, on 22 September 2026, the National School of Administration and the agency [signed a partnership to build public-sector workers' skills in digital transformation, AI and data management](<https://en.7news.ma/ena-add-digital-skills-partnership/>). The numbers to be trained had not yet been announced. No source found since October 2023 says digital-skills training reaches civil servants across government. Operating would need the programme open to all ministries, or staff trained across most of government.

In August 2025 Minister Delmotte [said the ministry is training civil servants to handle the new digital identity systems](<https://kaori-media.com/posts/interview-with-hon-stephanie-delmotte-minister-of-of-digital-development-posts-and-telecommunications-of-madagascar-mndpt>). In the last twelve months, in September 2026, Madagascar Newsroom [reported a training session on AI use in administration](<https://www.madagascarnewsroom.com/2026/09/tresor-public-formation-ia.html>). It was held for the Treasury's director general and several colleagues. The partner was the Projet Poles Integres de Croissance (PIC), and the session was described as a first step. No source found since October 2023 says a standing programme is in service. Establishing would need a programme, academy or platform in service with a stated number of civil servants trained.

On 1 September 2026 AGEFAU [financed the launch of office-software and collaborative-tools training for 504 elected officials and staff of 126 communes](<https://agefaumali.com/archives/partenariat-agefau-matd-pour-le-renforcement-des-capacites-des-collectivites-territoriales-du-mali/>). In the last twelve months, the Centre de Formation des Collectivités Territoriales has run that training. Its first session drew 84 participants from 21 communes. In September 2022 AGETIC [held a workshop, chaired by the minister, to train ministries' communication officers on the gouv.ml government email](<https://bamada.net/agetic-la-modernisation-a-travers-lutilisation-dune-messagerie-securisee-et-credible>). No source found since October 2023 says a standing programme is in service. Establishing would need a programme, academy or platform in service with a stated number of civil servants trained.

By November 2025 [7,033 public servants (3,746 women, 3,287 men) had been trained in digital skills under the Public Administration Reform and Modernisation Programme](<https://www.oeconomico.com/governo-reforca-estrategia-de-digitalizacao-com-500-assinaturas-electronicas-e-expansao-da-infra-estrutura-tecnologica/>). Jornal Noticias reports MCTES data showing [more than 33,000 public servants, state agents and young people trained in ICT use in 2020-2023 through INAGE](<https://jornalnoticias.co.mz/ciencia-e-ambiente/funcionarios-publicos-formados-em-tecnologias/>). In the last twelve months, in March 2026, [the communications ministry trained staff of MEC, INTIC and the ministry itself](<https://pt.linkedin.com/posts/minist%C3%A9rio-das-comunica%C3%A7%C3%B5es-e-transforma%C3%A7%C3%A3o-digital-6a8158337_capacita%C3%A7%C3%A3o-refor%C3%A7a-compet%C3%AAncias-digitais-activity-7444322822627233793-JZeq>). The training covered the e-SuRA, CorreioGov, CloudGov and Digital Signer systems. No source found since October 2023 says digital-skills training reaches civil servants across government. Operating would need the programme open to all ministries, or staff trained across most of government.

In December 2025 the ministers of digital transformation and public service [launched a twelve-week cybersecurity and AI course for 300 civil servants](<https://ami.mr/fr/archives/285526>). A distance-learning centre runs it with German cooperation.
